targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS events, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (1)

panels.title: Resolved build
panels.description: Latest is resolved across sources for the selected game/environment, independently of the time picker. It follows the most recent event, including late uploads.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AS build_version

panels.title: Accepted event volume over time
panels.description: Deduplicated events per adaptive time bucket; not events per second. Counts per adaptive time bucket; empty buckets have no bar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, count() AS events FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (1) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Client delivery counters in selected range

targets.rawSql: SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'stat') AS metric, sum(JSONExtractFloat(properties,'change')) AS value FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='stat_changed' AND startsWith(JSONExtractString(properties,'stat'),'telemetry_')) GROUP BY metric ORDER BY value DESC, metric LIMIT 20

SELECT event_name, schema_version, count() AS events FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (1) GROUP BY event_name, schema_version ORDER BY events DESC, event_name, schema_version LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Ingestion counters — global process totals
panels.description: Global cumulative process counters; ignores game/build/source filters. Drops indicate process resets. Requests count batches; accepted counts events. Values are raw snapshots, never summed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, requests, accepted, rejected, rate_limited, storage_failures FROM telemetry.ingest_health WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp

list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT 'Latest reporting build' AS __text, '__latest__' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT build_version AS __text, build_version AS __value FROM (SELECT build_version, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY last_seen DESC, build_version DESC)
list.label: Build
list.description: Latest event timestamp for this game/environment, across sources and outside the time picker. Select a version to pin history.

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type

title: Telemetry Health
description: Defaults to the latest reporting build for the selected game/environment, across sources. Historical builds remain selectable. Panels respect the selected time range and source unless labeled global.
